title: OAuth URL Builder
description: Build OAuth 2.0 authorization URLs for Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Discord or a custom provider.
howto: Choose the provider (or Custom for your own endpoint).
Enter client ID, redirect URI and scopes.
Optionally generate a random state value.
Copy the authorization URL or download it.

faqs.a: Google, GitHub, Microsoft (common endpoint) and Discord, plus a Custom option where you paste any authorization endpoint.
Each provider preselects sensible defaults (e.g. openid email profile for Google). Adjust to the permissions your app needs.
A random value your app checks on callback to prevent CSRF attacks. Use the Generate button for a cryptographically random one.

faqs.q: Does this complete the OAuth flow?
faqs.a: No — it builds the authorization URL you redirect users to. Your backend still exchanges the returned code for tokens.
